Definition: from the multiplicative adverb of G5064 and G5507; four times a thousand:--four thousand.
BiblicalUsage: In the Bible, tetrakischílioi means four thousand. In Matthew 15:38, they that did eat were four thousand men, and it appears again in Mark 8:9.
TheologicalSignificance: Four thousand fed with almost nothing reminds me that Jesus never asks me to count what I lack before He provides.
